explanation: Compared against Green's 100 open problems, Problem 97: in how many ways (asymptotically) Q(n) can n non-attacking queens be placed on an n×n board? Green notes that an asymptotic, rather than one for the log, remains open. numQueens counts permutations with injective σ(i) - i and σ(i) + i over ℤ (tests: Q(3) = 0, Q(4) = 2). The statement asks for answer with Q(n) ~ answer(n), exactly the open 'asymptotic' question. Faithful.
